notes.title: Thanks for Joining Us at Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: [p]A huge thank you to everyone who played our demo during Steam Next Fest! Your feedback is incredibly valuable, and we're already working on it to prepare a big update that will make the game even better.[/p][p]We can’t wait to see you again soon for the Early Access launch![/p]

notes.title: The Mnemograph Demo is Now Available!
notes.content:
Great news! The Mnemograph demo is now live and free to play.
Get a first taste of the gameplay, experience the atmosphere, and let us know what you think!

👉 Download the demo directly from our Steam page and share your feedback on the Steam Community Hub or our Discord.

Thank you for your support — and enjoy the game!

notes.title: The Mnemograph is joining Steam Next Fest – June 9–16, 2025
notes.content:
We’re excited to share that The Mnemograph will be part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest, happening this June 2025.

A playable demo will be available throughout the event — a first glimpse at what we’re building, and a chance for you to dive in and share your feedback.

Please note: the game is still in development. Content, visuals, and features are subject to change and improvement as we continue working on it.

Thanks for being part of the journey — see you at the Fest!
